newsitem.title: BOSNIA: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR BOSNIA V ITALY FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR BOSNIA V ITALY FRIENDLY.

text.p: Bosnia and Italy on Tuesday named their teams for a friendly at Sarajevo's Kosevo stadium on Wednesday.
Italy coach Arrigo Sacchi told a news conference that those players not named in his starting lineup would come on as substitutes in the second half.

Bosnia - 1-Mirsad Dedic; 2-Hermin Glabic, 3-Bahir Besirevic, 4-Muhamad Kokic, 5-Senad Begic, 6-Murat Jasarevic, 7-Vlaiko Glavas, 8-Sejad Halilovic, 9-Meho Kodro, 10-Hasan Salihamidzic, 11-Elvir Bolic.

Italy - 1-Francesco Toldo, 2-Paolo Maldini, 3-Pasquale Padalino, 4-Moreno Torricelli, 5-Daniele Carnasciali, 6-Demetrio Albertini, 7-Roberto Di Matteo, 8-Dino Baggio, 9-Gianfranco Zola, 10-Enrico Chiesa, 11-Pierluigi Casiraghi.
